offering_description.value: Develops, makes and sells minimally invasive orthopedic treatments for pain, joint and bone repair, including hyaluronic acid injections, bone graft substitutes, bone growth stimulators and surgical tools. Sells to orthopedic surgeons, pain specialists, hospitals and clinics.

primary_products.value: hyaluronic acid knee injections; bone growth stimulators; bone graft substitutes; peripheral nerve ablation devices; ultrasonic surgical tools

customer_segment.value: B2B: orthopedic surgeons, pain management physicians, hospitals, surgery centers, clinics; B2C: patients using bone growth stimulators and injections, billed via insurers

end_markets.value: orthopedics; pain management; sports medicine; spine surgery; trauma and bone repair

revenue_model.value: product sales: injectables, devices and bone grafts sold to providers and hospitals; healthcare reimbursement: insurer-reimbursed bone growth stimulators and injections

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: makes and sources medical devices and biologics, sold to providers and hospitals; brand owner: markets branded orthobiologic products, some made by third-party contract manufacturers

geography_served.value: global: United States primarily, plus Europe, Asia-Pacific and other international markets

specialization.value: related lines: pain treatments, surgical solutions and restorative therapies, all musculoskeletal

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales reps selling to surgeons, hospitals and clinics; distributors / dealers: independent distributors and international distributors

regulatory_exposure.value: high: medical devices and biologics needing FDA clearance or approval, EU MDR, reimbursement and healthcare compliance rules
